title: Booking-Notice Adjustment to Household Member Rates — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
A household member's rate at a **Specimen Collection Appointments** home visit (Mobile In-Home Collection Visit) moves with the booking notice. The notice is counted in calendar days from the booking date to the appointment date, both read from the visit record.

| Input: notice | Judgement | Output: change to each member's rate |
|---|---|---|
| Three days or fewer | Short notice | Adds 5.00 to each member's rate |
| Four to 13 days | Neither short nor long | Leaves the rate unchanged |
| 14 days or more | Long notice | Takes 3.00 off each member's rate |

**Clause.** Counting calendar days from the booking date to the appointment date, a visit booked three days or fewer ahead adds 5.00 to each member's rate, a visit booked 14 days or more ahead takes 3.00 off each member's rate, and a visit booked four to 13 days ahead leaves the rate unchanged.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical bookings)

| Notice | Change per member |
|---|---|
| 3 days | Plus 5.00 |
| 4 days | None |
| 13 days | None |
| 14 days | Minus 3.00 |

The change applies to each member's rate, so it is carried by every member drawn at the visit.
